content.comment_body: Hello, I was reviewing the [product_name] manual and noticed a potential inconsistency in the section referenced by the attached image. Specifically, for point 2, I'm unsure whether this detail applies to both [product_name] 230RCE and 230RCo, or just to 230RCo. The manual says: '230 VAC versions: Two groups consisting of four inputs each. Each input within a group must be connected to the same phase. You can connect groups to different phases.' Since it's stated for 230VAC versions, does that mean all 230VAC models are included?
Another question: Regarding point 3—'Digital inputs can be operated either with P or N action.' Does this advice apply to the DM16 module as well, specifically DM16 24R?
Please see the attached image. It shows the wiring arrangement when working with multiple phases. The setup is the same regardless of whether the [product_name] 230 module has a display or not.
This explanation only pertains to [product_name] 24 RCE(o), DM8 24R, and DM16 24R modules, because these can be powered by either 24 VDC or 24 VAC depending on the version.
Observing the second image, the power supply section lists only 24VDC for DM16R and not 24VAC/DC. Is this another error in the documentation? Can we still use both P and N operations for DM16R?
You're correct—only the DM8 24R module supports both 24 VDC/AC as a power supply.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants noted inconsistencies in the [product_name] manual regarding power supply and input wiring details across different module types. Unclear documentation led to users questioning its reliability, especially regarding the operational specifications of certain modules.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are hoping for documentation that is both precise and comprehensive, detailing wiring and power supply requirements for every module variant. They expect clear instructions that distinguish between hardware models and explain which specifications apply to each.
